subtitle: Player Handbook, Device Guides & Addon Nexus Integration
changes: Added a searchable, lightweight Player Handbook covering 20 major studio groups and related utilities with step-by-step guidance, limitations, and direct links.
Integrated separate PC and mobile handbook links into the main companion navigation without replacing existing studio controls.
Added device-aware tutorial instructions, keyboard and mobile usage tips, accessibility and reduced-motion accommodations.
Introduced the independent Addon Nexus v8.0 preview directory as a navigation destination; live provider API search remains a future optional integration.
Kept Battle.net authentication, Cloudflare Worker, local player records, talent planning and all existing script bundles unchanged.
Performance-focused design: the new handbook uses a standalone lightweight page, expandable sections, and filtered searches; no measured site-wide speedup is claimed.
